description: This file defines the EmployeeBenefitClaim class and related functions for managing employee benefit claims, including validation, benefit calculations, and pro-rata benefit handling within the payroll system.

classes.name: EmployeeBenefitClaim
classes.description: Class representing an employee benefit claim document with validation and benefit calculation methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the employee benefit claim, including employee status, benefit limits, and payroll period.

methods.name: validate_benefit_claim_amount
methods.description: Checks if the claimed amount exceeds the maximum benefits.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit_for_sal_struct
methods.description: Validates if the claimed amount exceeds the maximum benefit for salary structure.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit_for_component
methods.description: Validates if the claimed amount exceeds the maximum amount eligible for a specific component.

methods.name: validate_non_pro_rata_benefit_claim
methods.description: Validates benefit claim against pro-rata calculations and maximum limits.

methods.name: get_pro_rata_amount_in_application
methods.description: Retrieves the pro-rata dispensed amount from an existing benefit application.
